notes: story_notes_juno verdict: REWORK. I accept the six notes kept in the apron; it is exactly how I love things, by keeping them. I veto 'thinks Tilda wrote them' as fact: I noticed Juno's clasp closing the first time, she labels everything in my forge including my apron (overheard_juno_bram_1), and Tilda's and my slate runs on repairs and pie, never notes (overheard_tilda_bram_1). Rework: the misattribution is Juno's belief, not mine - she thinks she fooled me; I know her hand and say nothing. Juno's scene text can likely stand if the claim sits in her mouth; if the Director wants my side visible, I will take a one-line add next pass.
Juno's mark (anvil with a J): confirmed I describe her mark nowhere - next_door and hall_dance leave the mark in Juno's mouth. Nothing to align.
